item.title: Weekend rail closure scheduled between Oceanside, San Diego
item.description: North County Transit - San Diego Railroad will suspend all coastal rail service this weekend, starting tomorrow, to perform routine railroad maintenance and major infrastructure work.

item.title: Ghislaine Maxwell fights release of more Epstein documents, calling disclosure law unconstitutional
item.description: Lawyers for imprisoned British socialite Ghislaine Maxwell are fighting the requested release of 90,000 pages related to disgraced financier Jeffrey Epstein and Maxwell.

item.title: ABC 10News Pinpoint Forecast for Feb. 21, 2026: Rain in the rearview, warmer weather ahead
item.description: It's been a tale of two different forecasts — a warmer, sunnier weekend following rain, wind and much colder weather this week.
